technique_name: Construct a persuasive argument in favor of cutting taxes.
description: Lowering taxes can have a positive effect on people and businesses alike. For individuals, it puts more money back in their pockets, giving them the ability to save, invest, or to buy things that stimulate the economy. For businesses, lower taxes can allow them to expand and create jobs. It can also help them stay competitive in their market and can give them the resources to increase wages for their employees.
